verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Stripe documents an official MCP server at docs.stripe.com/mcp, so an agent can connect through a first-party MCP endpoint. However, it is a Stripe-wide server, and nothing in the evidence shows it exposes Treasury operations such as financial accounts, outbound payments or transactions. Missing for 10: evidence of Treasury-specific MCP tools, documented auth/setup details for agent connections, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
